sentences.en: I first learned about the existence of travel nurses early in the pandemic in the spring of 2020 when a friend of mine who worked as a nurse told me about some
sentences.zh: 我第一次了解到旅行护士的存在是在2020年春季疫情初期，当时我的一位护士朋友告诉我，她的一些

sentences.en: colleagues of hers who were traveling to New York City to help in what was then the biggest outbreak in the United States.

sentences.en: Travel nursing was already expanding well before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 其实在疫情之前，旅行护理行业就已经在扩张了。

sentences.en: Staffing agencies would be called in by hospitals to help cover the gaps in their own staffing, whether it be
sentences.zh: 医院会聘请人力资源中介来填补自身的人员缺口，无论是

sentences.en: During the pandemic, when hospitals were overwhelmed and the working conditions in ICUs and
sentences.zh: 疫情期间，当医院不堪重负，重症监护室（ICU）和

sentences.zh: 急诊室的工作条件日益恶化时，对旅行护士的需求激增，他们的薪酬也随之水涨船高。

sentences.en: Often, you would see travel nurses arriving at hospitals making two or three times the amount that a staff
sentences.zh: 你经常会看到，刚到医院的旅行护士的收入是正式

sentences.zh: 护士的两到三倍。正式护士们看到了这些机会，最终也纷纷离职去从事旅行护理工作。

sentences.en: COVID nursing is really difficult.
sentences.zh: 新冠护理工作真的非常艰难。

sentences.en: Before the pandemic, it was rare for a nurse to take on more than one patient on a ventilator.
sentences.zh: 疫情前，一名护士同时照看多名使用呼吸机的患者是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: But during COVID, maybe all your patients are on ventilators.
sentences.zh: 但在新冠疫情期间，可能你所有的患者都在使用呼吸机。

sentences.en: So nurses are taxing their technical abilities, they're watching countless people die, and they're setting aside their own emotions to care for the
sentences.zh: 因此，护士们不仅在挑战技术极限，还要目睹无数人离世，同时还得压抑自己的情绪，去照顾那些

sentences.en: people who are really scared and sick and in their ICU.
sentences.zh: 在重症监护室里极度恐惧和病重的患者。

sentences.en: All of the nurses I spoke with mentioned the toll that this was
sentences.zh: 我采访的所有护士都提到了这带来的沉重负担。

sentences.en: We actually don't know how many nurses have retired or left the bedside in the past two years, but we know it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们并不清楚过去两年里有多少护士退休或离开了临床一线，但我们知道人数非常多。

sentences.en: And if there was competition for talent before, it's nothing compared to what we're seeing today.

sentences.en: In the early morning on Mother's Day in 2020, Solomon Barassa walked into an intensive care unit in Amarillo, Texas, and with the fluorescent
sentences.zh: 2020年母亲节的清晨，所罗门·巴拉萨走进德克萨斯州阿马里洛的一间重症监护室，在夜班结束后，头顶的荧光

sentences.en: lights clicking on above him after the night shift, flipped through the stack of papers attached to a gray clipboard.
sentences.zh: 灯啪地亮起，他翻阅着夹在灰色写字板上的一叠文件。

sentences.en: His roster of patients and nurses for the day.
sentences.zh: 那是他当天负责的患者和护士名单。

sentences.en: Barassa, who was 30 at the time, had only recently become a charged nurse at Northwest Texas
sentences.zh: 当时30岁的巴拉萨，不久前才刚刚成为西北德克萨斯

sentences.en: Healthcare System Hospital.
sentences.zh: 医疗系统医院的责任护士。

sentences.en: He was technically still a baby nurse.
sentences.zh: 从资历上看，他还是个新手。

sentences.en: Just over a year earlier, he started working his first shifts in the ICU.
sentences.zh: 就在一年多前，他才刚刚开始在ICU值第一个班。

sentences.en: Now, he was responsible for overseeing the care of everyone there, making sure his nurses and patients had
sentences.zh: 现在，他负责监督那里所有人的护理工作，确保他的护士和患者拥有

sentences.en: whatever they needed, answering questions, and directing care in case of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 他们所需的一切，回答各种问题，并在紧急情况下指挥护理工作。

sentences.en: As he looked through his roster, he saw that there were
sentences.zh: 当他查看名单时，发现

sentences.en: 11 patients on his floor.
sentences.zh: 他所在的楼层有11名患者。

sentences.en: Eight had COVID-19, and five of those were intubated.
sentences.zh: 其中8人感染了新冠，5人已经插管。

sentences.en: Then he looked at the other sheet of paper.
sentences.zh: 接着他看了看另一张纸。

sentences.en: There would be four nurses working for the next 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 接下来的12小时里只有4名护士在岗。

sentences.en: He needed at least six.
sentences.zh: 他至少需要6名。

sentences.en: He could see the day play out.
sentences.zh: 他预见到了接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: A cascade of emergencies, a cacophony of beeping alarms and running feet, disasters that ended with overwhelmed nurses and patients crashing alone.
sentences.zh: 接连不断的紧急情况，刺耳的警报声和匆忙的脚步声，最终以护士精疲力竭、患者孤独离世而告终的灾难。

sentences.en: And so, for the first time, Barassa made the decision to call for
sentences.zh: 于是，巴拉萨第一次做出了决定，申请

sentences.en: Safe Harbor, under a Texas law that can be invoked to protect nurses' licenses while working in conditions that are potentially unsafe for patients.
sentences.zh: “安全港”（Safe Harbor），这是德克萨斯州的一项法律，旨在保护在对患者可能不安全的条件下工作的护士的执照。

sentences.en: Barassa grabbed a form from the nurse's station, and one by one, they all signed it.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨从护士站拿了一份表格，大家一个接一个地签了名。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, the emergencies began.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，紧急情况就开始了。

sentences.en: You need to get over to 18, someone shouted.
sentences.zh: “快去18号房！”有人喊道。

sentences.en: Barassa grabbed his mask and ran.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨抓起口罩就跑。

sentences.en: He started hand-pumping air into the patient's lungs with a ventilation bag, while two other nurses hooked the bag up to oxygen.
sentences.zh: 他开始用呼吸气囊手动为患者肺部供氧，而另外两名护士则将气囊连接到氧气源上。

sentences.en: They stabilized that patient.
sentences.zh: 他们稳住了那名患者。

sentences.en: They stabilized that patient, and Barassa jogged down the hallways to check on the other seven.
sentences.zh: 稳住患者后，巴拉萨又跑向走廊去查看其他七个人。

sentences.en: One person's blood pressure was dropping precipitously, and Barassa was preparing to go inside the room when he thought to check on another patient one door down.
sentences.zh: 其中一人的血压正在急剧下降，巴拉萨正准备进房间时，想到要去隔壁查看另一名患者。

sentences.en: That patient's blood oxygen level had dropped into the 40s, far below the normal range of 95 to 100.
sentences.zh: 那名患者的血氧水平已经降到了40多，远低于95到100的正常范围。

sentences.en: So what do I do?
sentences.zh: “那我该怎么办？”

sentences.en: Barassa said.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨说。

sentences.en: Who do I help first?
sentences.zh: “我该先救谁？”

sentences.en: There are multiple people's lives at stake at the same time.
sentences.zh: 同时有多个人的生命危在旦夕。

sentences.en: What if I pick wrong and someone dies?
sentences.zh: “如果我选错了，有人死了怎么办？”

sentences.en: A year and a half later, Barassa was sitting on the desk in the middle of the cardiac intensive care unit, or CICU, which handles both coronary and COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 一年半后，巴拉萨坐在心脏重症监护室（CICU）中间的桌子上，这里同时收治冠心病和新冠患者。

sentences.en: Looking around the group of nurses, remembering those first months of an ongoing crisis.
sentences.zh: 他环顾着这群护士，回忆起那场持续危机最初的几个月。

sentences.en: There were some funky things going on with staffing back then, he told the group.
sentences.zh: “那时候的人员配置确实有些乱，”他告诉大家。

sentences.en: Nurses were leaving the hospital to take traveling jobs in New York.
sentences.zh: 护士们纷纷离开医院，去纽约从事旅行护理工作。

sentences.en: The rest of the hospital was shut down, so the ICU floor was the chaotic heart of a ghost town.
sentences.zh: 医院的其他部门都关闭了，所以ICU楼层成了这座“鬼城”里混乱的核心。

sentences.en: The hospital had yet to hire traveling nurses to pad its local staff, and Mother's Day felt like a turning point.
sentences.zh: 医院当时还没有聘请旅行护士来补充本地员工，而那个母亲节感觉像是一个转折点。

sentences.en: It was the day Barassa recognized that the pandemic would be defined by twin emergencies, two figures that he would watch anxiously as they rose and fell,
sentences.zh: 那天，巴拉萨意识到这场疫情将由两场孪生危机来定义，他将焦虑地注视着这两个数字的起伏：

sentences.en: the waves of patients on ventilators in his ICU, and the number of nurses available to take care of them.
sentences.zh: ICU里使用呼吸机的患者数量，以及可供护理他们的护士人数。

sentences.en: In 2020 alone, Northwest lost 185 nurses, nearly 20% of its nursing staff.
sentences.zh: 仅在2020年，西北医院就流失了185名护士，占其护理人员总数的近20%。

sentences.en: In the ICU, that number was closer to 80%.
sentences.zh: 在ICU，这个数字接近80%。

sentences.en: Many of those nurses left to take jobs with travel nursing agencies, which placed them, on a temporary and highly lucrative basis, in hospitals throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 许多护士离职加入了旅行护理中介机构，这些机构将他们以临时且高薪的方式安置在全国各地的医院中。

sentences.en: When the nurses at Northwest quit, the hospital eventually hired its own travelers, who flowed onto Barassa's floor to work for weeks or months at a time.
sentences.zh: 当西北医院的护士辞职后，医院最终也聘请了自己的旅行护士，他们一批批涌入巴拉萨的楼层，每次工作几周或几个月。

sentences.en: There have been days when the unit was barely staffed, and days when
sentences.zh: 有时科室里几乎没人手，有时又

sentences.en: 20 travelers showed up unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 突然冒出20名旅行护士。

sentences.en: Barassa has watched friends burn out and retire.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨看着朋友们精疲力竭并选择退休。

sentences.en: He has watched nurses leave for better pay or less stressful jobs.
sentences.zh: 他看着护士们为了更高的薪水或压力较小的工作而离开。

sentences.en: He has welcomed the strangers who have come to take their place, befriending them, folding them into his ICU team, and then watching them leave all over again.
sentences.zh: 他欢迎那些前来接替职位的陌生人，与他们交朋友，将他们融入自己的ICU团队，然后又看着他们再次离开。

sentences.en: Bedside nursing has always been, as one hospital chief executive put it, a burnout profession.
sentences.zh: 正如一位医院首席执行官所言，临床护理一直是一个“易耗型”职业。

sentences.en: The work is hard.
sentences.zh: 工作很辛苦。

sentences.en: It is physical and emotional, and hospitals have built shortages into their business model, keeping their staff's lane and their labor costs down.
sentences.zh: 它不仅是体力的消耗，更是情感的磨损，而医院将人员短缺纳入了商业模式，以此来压缩员工编制和劳动力成本。

sentences.en: When the pandemic hit, shortages only increased, pushing hospitals to the breaking point.
sentences.zh: 疫情来袭时，短缺问题进一步加剧，将医院推向了崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Nationwide, the tally of nurses with both the skills and the willingness to endure the punishing routines of COVID nursing, the isolation rooms,
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，既有技能又愿意忍受新冠护理残酷日常的护士人数正在减少，包括隔离病房、

sentences.en: the angry families, and the unceasing drumbeat of death is dwindling.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的家属，以及永不停歇的死亡丧钟。

sentences.en: In a survey of critical care nurses last year, 66% of respondents said they were considering retirement.
sentences.zh: 在去年的一项重症监护护士调查中，66%的受访者表示他们正在考虑退休。

sentences.en: Sitting on the desk that day, Barassa didn't know why he kept reflecting on May 2020.
sentences.zh: 那天坐在桌边，巴拉萨不知道自己为什么一直回想2020年5月。

sentences.en: He had stabilized those two patients that morning, but that would not always be the case.
sentences.zh: 那天早上他稳住了那两名患者，但情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: For the most part, he said, the days bleed together in his mind.
sentences.zh: 他说，在很大程度上，那些日子在他的记忆里已经模糊成了一片。

sentences.en: Sometimes it felt as if he had spent the last two years running the world's longest marathon,
sentences.zh: 有时感觉就像他过去两年一直在跑一场世界上最长的马拉松，

sentences.en: his adrenaline pushing him from patient to patient, watching people die, and trying his best to pause
sentences.zh: 肾上腺素驱使他从一个患者奔向另一个患者，目睹人们离世，并尽力让自己停下来

sentences.en: for a moment, just enough time to recognize each as an individual without being overwhelmed by emotion.
sentences.zh: 片刻，哪怕只是为了把每个人当作独立的个体来对待，而不被情绪淹没。

sentences.en: That was the first time we called for safe harbor, said Matt Melvin, a veteran nurse who has stayed with Barassa throughout the pandemic.
sentences.zh: “那是我们第一次申请安全港，”一直与巴拉萨并肩作战的资深护士马特·梅尔文说。

sentences.en: But it was definitely not the laSt. In the flood of resignations, retirements, and shortages that have redefined workplaces across industries these past
sentences.zh: “但这绝对不是最后一次。”在过去两年里，重塑了各行各业工作场所的辞职潮、退休潮和短缺潮中，没有任何变化像护理行业这样剧烈且影响深远。

sentences.en: two years, nothing has been as dramatic or as consequential as the shifts taking place in nursing.
sentences.zh: 对临床护士的争夺与我们运营医院的方式、

sentences.en: The scramble for bedside nurses is tied to everything from how we run our hospitals
sentences.zh: 我们评估护理他人工作的价值的方式，以及我们对公共卫生和医学的理解，都息息相关。

sentences.en: to the way we value the work of caring for others to our understanding of public health and medicine.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的医疗体系在疫情的重压下摇摇欲坠，那么它将需要数十万名更多的护士来重建自身。

sentences.en: And if our health care system has faltered under the weight of the pandemic, it will need hundreds of thousands more nurses to build itself back up.
sentences.zh: 至少三十年来，全美的医院一直遵循一种旨在将护士人数与占用床位精确匹配的模式。

sentences.en: For at least three decades, hospitals across the United States have followed a model that aims to match nurses precisely to the number of occupied beds.
sentences.zh: 这是一个猜谜游戏，责任护士每天进行统计，医院管理者预测疾病和人员的季节性流动，

sentences.en: It's a guessing game that has charge nurses performing daily tallies and hospital administrators anticipating the seasonal movements of illness and people,
sentences.zh: 比如冬季流感和迁徙的退休人员。

sentences.en: winter flus, and migrating retirees.
sentences.zh: 许多医院并不为护士提供明确的职业晋升或加薪途径。

sentences.en: Many hospitals don't offer nurses clear paths toward career advancement or pay increases.
sentences.zh: 根据需求，他们可能会在不同科室间调配护士。

sentences.en: Depending on demand, they may trade nurses between units.
sentences.zh: 当全院出现短缺时，他们会发送电子邮件和短信，请求护士前来加班，多上一个12小时的班。

sentences.en: When there are shortages throughout the hospital, they will send out emails and text messages asking nurses to come in and take an extra 12-hour shift.
sentences.zh: 而当短缺过于严重时，

sentences.en: And when the shortages are too great,
sentences.zh: 医院就会转向旅行护士。

sentences.en: hospitals turn to travelers.
sentences.zh: 即使在疫情之前，聘请旅行护士也有很多理由。

sentences.en: Even before the pandemic, there were many reasons to hire travelers.
sentences.zh: 护士会被请来应对某个季节、产假或新部门的开设。

sentences.en: Nurses would be brought in for a season, a maternity leave or the opening of a new department.

sentences.zh: 巴拉萨的病房位于西北医院北侧大楼的四楼。

sentences.en: Not long afterward, she was transferred to another ward, where many of the nurses were younger than she was.
sentences.zh: 那里灯火通明，空间宽敞，大多数门上都贴着黄色的标志，提醒每个人需要穿戴个人防护装备。

sentences.en: Kania worked a relatively manageable five days each week, although the job was still grueling.
sentences.zh: 重症监护室（MICU）与心脏重症监护室（CICU）之间隔着一排电梯，沙塔克在结束旅行护理后，一直在这里担任正式护士。

sentences.en: I am not afraid of running toward the fire, she told me.
sentences.zh: 那里灯光昏暗，大多数病人处于医学麻痹状态，以便呼吸机能在没有阻力的情况下工作。

sentences.en: And the staff nurses were welcoming.
sentences.zh: 警报声响起，监护仪对着玻璃，每个病人的氧气水平在走廊里闪烁。

sentences.en: Some stopped to ask Kania for advice on how to start traveling themselves.
sentences.zh: 重症监护护理需要一套特殊的技能。

sentences.en: Barasa's unit sits on the fourth floor of a tower on the north side of NorthweSt.
sentences.zh: 这里的护士监测生命维持设备，跟踪病人对药物的反应，并在紧急情况下迅速做出反应。

sentences.en: It is brightly lit and wide, and most doors have a yellow sign alerting everyone to the need for personal protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 这可能是体力活。

sentences.en: The Medical Intensive Care Unit, or MICU, where Shattuck's has been working as a staff nurse after her stint as a traveler, is separated from the CICU by a bank of elevators.
sentences.zh: 例如，在不拆除任何设备的情况下翻动病人，需要多个人配合。

sentences.en: There, the lights are dim, and most of the patients have been medically paralyzed, so the ventilators can work without resistance.
sentences.zh: 重症监护护士受过培训，可以滴定多种药物和输液。

sentences.en: Alarms beep, and monitors are facing the glass, the oxygen levels of each patient blinking toward the hallways.
sentences.zh: 优秀的护士可以预判病人何时即将崩溃。

sentences.en: ICU nursing demands a particular set of skills.
sentences.zh: 他们被要求处理不可预测的情况和不稳定的病人。

sentences.en: Nurses here monitor life support equipment, track patients' reactions to medications, and respond quickly in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 卡尼亚说，如果你不使用这些技能，你就会生疏。

sentences.en: It can be physical work.
sentences.zh: 2020年12月，卡尼亚抵达阿马里洛，加入巴拉萨的团队执行任务。

sentences.en: It takes multiple people, for example, to turn a patient without unhooking any equipment.
sentences.zh: 到那时，医院已经见过一波又一波的旅行护士来来去去。

sentences.en: ICU nurses are trained to titrate several medications and drips.
sentences.zh: 疫情前，潜在的旅行护士会由机构仔细审查其专业知识和信誉。

sentences.en: Good nurses can anticipate when a patient is about to crash.
sentences.zh: 他们被要求在自己的专业领域至少工作一年，有时是两三年。

sentences.en: They're expected to handle situations that are unpredictable, and patients who are unstable.
sentences.zh: 卡尼亚本人则拥有八年的护理经验。

sentences.en: If you don't use those skills, Kenia said, you lose it.
sentences.zh: 然而，在疫情初期，由于医院员工短缺并寻求立即缓解，许多当地护士和管理人员对一些降落在他们重症监护室的旅行护士的经验水平表示怀疑。

sentences.en: In December 2020, Kenia arrived in Amarillo for an assignment on Barasa's team.
sentences.zh: 当一批批旅行护士开始抵达阿马里洛时，巴拉萨在他们消失之前几乎没有时间与他们建立联系。

sentences.en: By that time, the hospital had already seen waves of travelers come and go.
sentences.zh: 他们的合同没有规定他们需要在任何特定的医院停留多久，有些人几周内就会离开。

sentences.en: Before the pandemic, potential travel nurses were carefully vetted by agencies for expertise and good standing.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨工作的班次中，他是唯一的核心员工，不确定谁有处理紧急情况的经验。

sentences.en: They were required to have clocked at least a year in their specialty, sometimes two or three.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，有些旅行护士来了，他们非常棒。

sentences.en: Kenia, for her part, had eight years of nursing experience under her belt.
sentences.zh: 他们是我合作过的最好的护士之一。

sentences.en: During the early days of the pandemic, however, with hospital staffs suffering from shortages and
sentences.zh: 但也有一些本不该出现在那里的人。

sentences.en: looking for immediate relief, many local nurses and administrators had doubts about the level of experience of some of the travelers who were landing in their ICUs.
sentences.zh: 如果说旅行护士在疫情前和疫情期间面临的挑战是在陌生的环境中完成工作，那么留下的护士面临的挑战就是在混乱中提供稳定性。

sentences.en: When groups of travel nurses started arriving in Amarillo, Barasa barely had time to connect with them before they disappeared.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨在疫情早期就知道他会留下来。

sentences.en: Their contracts didn't stipulate how long they needed to stay in any particular hospital, and some would be gone within weeks.
sentences.zh: 他承担起了保持士气的工作，带着像最喜欢的阿姨一样的活力来上班。

sentences.en: Barasa worked shifts in which he was the only member of the core staff, unsure of who had the experience to handle an emergency.
sentences.zh: 他开始带篮子的糖果和零食。

sentences.en: There were some travelers that came, and they were amazing, he told me.
sentences.zh: 他了解护士们的情绪，知道哪些病人感到害怕，需要陪伴。

sentences.en: They were some of the best nurses I've worked with.
sentences.zh: 他知道谁需要休息，谁还能坚持。

sentences.en: But then there were the ones who shouldn't have been there.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，当护士们发现自己面临来自外部世界前所未有的敌意时，提振士气的工作变得更加困难。

sentences.en: If the challenge for travelers before and during the pandemic has been to do their job in an unfamiliar environment, the challenge for the nurses
sentences.zh: 现在西北医院重症监护室里的大多数新冠患者都没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: who stayed was to offer consistency amid the chaos.
sentences.zh: 该地区的疫苗接种率徘徊在50%以下，餐馆和商场里挤满了不戴口罩的人。

sentences.en: Barasa knew early in the pandemic that he would stay.
sentences.zh: 巴拉萨团队的资深成员梅尔文说，这份工作最困难的部分之一就是走出医院，进入一个似乎疫情已经结束的世界。

sentences.en: He took on the job of keeping up morale and arrived at his shifts with the energy of a favorite aunt.
sentences.zh: 他说，你在这里，这里是战区，而你走出去，外面却没有战争。

sentences.en: He started taking in baskets of candy and snacks.
sentences.zh: 我的一生都在为大流行做准备。

sentences.en: He knew the moods of his nurses and which patients were feeling scared and in need of company.
sentences.zh: 但在那些会议和演习中，没有人说过：如果发生大流行，而没人相信这是大流行怎么办？

sentences.en: He knew who needed a break and who could keep going.
sentences.zh: 病人家属现在每天对医护人员大喊大叫，要求未经证实的治疗方法，或指责护士造成伤害。

sentences.en: As time went on, the work of boosting morale became more difficult as nurses found themselves facing an unprecedented level of hostility from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 他们反对插管或拒绝戴口罩。

sentences.en: A majority of COVID patients now in the ICU at Northwest are unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 沙迪克斯仍然记得有一次一个家庭因为他们亲人的去世而责怪她。

sentences.en: The region hovers below a 50% vaccination rate, and restaurants and malls are filled with unmasked people.
sentences.zh: 她说，我会永远对我的病人保持同情心，但我对家属的同情心快用完了。

sentences.en: Melvin, the veteran on Barasa's team, said that one of the most difficult parts of the job is walking outside the hospital into a world where it seems that the
sentences.zh: 护士们有同情疲劳、疲劳疲劳和警报疲劳，对监护仪的哔哔声变得麻木。

sentences.en: pandemic is already over.
sentences.zh: 西北医院的护士们会梦见病人崩溃，梦见自己被插管。

sentences.en: You are here and it's a war zone, and you walk outside and there's no war, he said.
sentences.zh: 梦见自己在床垫上做胸外按压而惊醒。

sentences.en: My whole life we've been preparing for a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 沙迪克斯在入睡时打开卡通片，以淹没脑海中不断响起的警报声。

sentences.en: But in none of those meetings, in none of those drills, did anyone say, what if there's a pandemic and nobody believes it's a pandemic?
sentences.zh: 她说，很多护士都很坚忍。

sentences.en: Families of patients now yell at staff daily, asking for unproven treatments or accusing nurses of doing harm.
sentences.zh: 他们忍着。

sentences.en: They oppose intubation or refuse to wear masks.
sentences.zh: 他们开玩笑。

sentences.en: Shaddix still remembers the time a family blamed her for the death of their loved one.
sentences.zh: 一位护士告诉我，上帝一定会保佑我忍受这一切废话的。

sentences.en: I will always have compassion for my patients, she said, but I'm running out of compassion for the families.
sentences.zh: 在糟糕的日子里，巴拉萨会握住护士的手，陪她们哭泣。

sentences.en: Nurses have compassion fatigue, fatigue fatigue, and alarm fatigue, becoming desensitized to the beeps of monitors.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，我们有一位经验丰富的护士，她当护士已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: Nurses at Northwest have nightmares about crashing patients, nightmares that they're being intubated themselves.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，她的病人要插管，她在走廊里哭着说，这不公平，她做不到。

sentences.en: Nightmares that wake them up doing chest compressions on their mattresses.
sentences.zh: 噩梦惊醒了他们，梦里他们还在床垫上做着胸外按压。

sentences.en: Shaddix turns on cartoons while she falls asleep to drown out the soundtrack of alarms that plays in her head.
sentences.zh: Shaddix在入睡时会打开动画片，以掩盖脑海中不断回响的警报声。

sentences.en: A lot of nurses are stoic, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，很多护士都很坚忍。

sentences.en: They hold it in.
sentences.zh: 他们把痛苦藏在心里。

sentences.en: They make jokes.
sentences.zh: 他们会开玩笑。

sentences.en: Surely the Lord is going to bless me for putting up with all of this crap, one nurse told me.
sentences.zh: 一位护士告诉我：‘上帝一定会保佑我忍受这一切烂摊子。’

sentences.en: On bad days, Barasa holds the nurse's hands while they cry.
sentences.zh: 在糟糕的日子里，Barasa会握住护士的手，陪她们一起哭。

sentences.en: We have a pretty well-versed nurse that has been a nurse for a long time, he told me.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，我们有一位经验非常丰富的护士，她当护士已经很久了。

sentences.en: But there was a day when her patient was going to be intubated, and she was in the hallway crying, saying that this isn't fair and she couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，当她的病人要进行插管时，她在走廊里哭了起来，说这不公平，她做不到。

sentences.en: I hugged her and I said, it sucks that it is this hard, but you're here for a reason.
sentences.zh: 我拥抱了她，对她说，现在这么艰难确实很糟糕，但你出现在这里是有原因的。

sentences.en: I am here for you, and you're here for me, and we're here for these people, he went on.
sentences.zh: 我在这里是为了你，你在这里是为了我，我们在这里是为了这些人，他继续说道。

sentences.en: I'm still trying to keep holding on to that aspect of my personality and who I am.
sentences.zh: 我仍在努力保持我个性的那一面，保持我原本的样子。

sentences.en: If I start losing that part of me, then I need to get out.
sentences.zh: 如果我开始失去那一部分自我，那我就得离开了。

sentences.en: When Shaddix was traveling, she left her daughter in the care of her mother and ex-husband, and struggled to leave her work at work, she said.
sentences.zh: Shaddix说，当她外出工作时，她把女儿托付给母亲和前夫照顾，但她很难做到把工作留在工作场所。

sentences.en: For months, she took it back to her hotel rooms and
sentences.zh: 几个月来，她把这些情绪带回酒店房间和

sentences.en: Airbnbs.
sentences.zh: 爱彼迎民宿里。

sentences.en: The faces of the patients she loSt. The feeling of doing chest compressions.
sentences.zh: 她失去的病人的面孔。做胸外按压的感觉。

sentences.en: The fear in people's eyes when they came in.
sentences.zh: 人们进来时眼中的恐惧。

sentences.en: Now, when she loses someone, she counts to 10 and allows herself to feel all her emotions.
sentences.zh: 现在，每当她失去一位病人，她就会数到10，让自己充分感受所有的情绪。

sentences.en: Then she takes a breath and does her best to put them aside.
sentences.zh: 然后她深吸一口气，尽力把这些情绪抛在脑后。

sentences.en: But for many other travelers, the exhaustion and the hostility they regularly face is blunted by their ability to do something staff nurses can't.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多其他流动护士来说，他们经常面临的疲惫和敌意，被他们能做而正式护士做不到的事情所抵消。

sentences.en: Leave.
sentences.zh: 离开。

sentences.en: Kania thinks that moving around has helped her navigate the emotional toll of the pandemic without losing hope.
sentences.zh: Kania认为，四处奔波帮助她应对了疫情带来的情感冲击，同时没有失去希望。

sentences.en: She has witnessed death firsthand.
sentences.zh: 她亲眼目睹了死亡。

sentences.en: But in episodes, each hospital providing a change of scenery.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是分阶段的，每家医院都提供了不同的风景。

sentences.en: And when she decommissions from an assignment, she allows herself a break before she takes a new job.
sentences.zh: 当她结束一项任务时，她会让自己在接受下一份工作前休息一下。

sentences.en: She feels overwhelmed at times, but never burned out.
sentences.zh: 她有时会感到不知所措，但从未感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: At the end of each shift, she assesses her day.
sentences.zh: 每班结束时，她都会评估自己的一天。

sentences.en: And if she feels she has done everything she can, she lets go of it as soon as she leaves the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 如果她觉得已经尽了全力，那么一旦离开停车场，她就会放下这一切。

sentences.en: Then, of course, there's the pay.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有薪水的问题。

sentences.en: Kania has made enough money to help cover the tuition to become a nurse anesthetiSt.
sentences.zh: Kania赚的钱足以支付她成为麻醉护士的学费。

sentences.en: Shaddix's six-month stint as a traveler allowed her to put a down payment on a house.
sentences.zh: Shaddix作为流动护士的六个月工作经历，让她能够支付房子的首付。

sentences.en: Chris Dettin, a traveler at Northwest, was also able to afford a down payment.
sentences.zh: Northwest医院的流动护士Chris Dettin也能够负担得起首付。

sentences.en: Adrian Chavira, Dettin's friend and another traveler at Northwest, said the money has made it possible for his partner to stay at home with their new baby.
sentences.zh: Dettin的朋友、同样在Northwest工作的流动护士Adrian Chavira说，这笔钱让他伴侣能够留在家中照顾他们的新生儿。

sentences.en: Money is a very good motivator, Dettin said.
sentences.zh: 钱是一个非常好的动力，Dettin说。

sentences.en: There's a sense that all the hard work is being rewarded.
sentences.zh: 人们会觉得所有的辛勤工作都得到了回报。

sentences.en: You don't have to worry about the politics of the hospital you're in.
sentences.zh: 你不必担心所在医院的政治斗争。

sentences.en: The power plays, the inter-office dramas, the personalities you can't escape.
sentences.zh: 那些权力博弈、办公室勾心斗角，以及你无法逃避的人际关系。

sentences.en: The travelers are insulated from it all.
sentences.zh: 流动护士与这一切隔绝。

sentences.en: I appreciate that they're here, said Karen Hammett, a long-time charge nurse at NorthweSt. Am I a little salty that they're making more than me?
sentences.zh: 我很感激他们能来，Northwest医院的资深主管护士Karen Hammett说。对于他们赚得比我多，我心里有点不平衡吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hammett was a veteran of the hospital.
sentences.zh: Hammett是这家医院的老员工了。

sentences.en: She had made it through every wave of the pandemic, but last year was her hardeSt. It's having to deal with the secondary stuff that gets to me.
sentences.zh: 她熬过了疫情的每一波冲击，但去年是她最艰难的一年。处理那些琐碎的杂事才最让我受不了。

sentences.en: The hate is what sucks, and it's the worst it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 那种仇恨才最糟糕，而且是有史以来最严重的。

sentences.en: She had her last shift at Northwest on November 21St. After nearly 20 years at the hospital, she quit.
sentences.zh: 她在Northwest的最后一个班次是11月21日。在医院工作了近20年后，她辞职了。

sentences.en: As ICU beds in city hospitals filled up and staff nurses started leaving in droves, another story of a precariously overextended healthcare system was unfolding in smaller
sentences.zh: 随着城市医院的ICU床位爆满，正式护士开始大量离职，另一个关于医疗系统岌岌可危的过度扩张的故事，正在全国各地的小型

sentences.en: hospitals across the country.
sentences.zh: 医院中上演。

sentences.en: Rural hospitals, which have long sent their most acute cases to larger hospitals, were left with patients they were ill-equipped to handle.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，农村医院会将最危重的病例转诊到大型医院，但现在它们不得不面对自己无力处理的病人。

sentences.en: Many of these hospitals, with lower profits and wages, struggled to retain nurses and compete with the enormous salaries offered by travel agencies.
sentences.zh: 这些医院利润和工资较低，很难留住护士，也无法与旅行护理机构提供的巨额薪水竞争。

sentences.en: With no padding, entire departments shut down.
sentences.zh: 由于没有缓冲，整个部门被迫关闭。

sentences.en: Only 40% of rural hospitals in Texas offer labor and delivery services.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州只有40%的农村医院提供分娩服务。

sentences.en: And with staffing shortages, many deliver babies only a few days a week.
sentences.zh: 由于人手短缺，许多医院每周只能接生几天。

sentences.en: There are 71 counties in the state with no hospitals at all.
sentences.zh: 该州有71个县根本没有医院。

sentences.en: Across the country,
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，

sentences.en: 22 rural hospitals have shuttered in the past two years.
sentences.zh: 过去两年里有22家农村医院倒闭。

sentences.en: According to one 2020 study, 453 more are in danger of closing.
sentences.zh: 根据2020年的一项研究，还有453家面临倒闭的危险。

sentences.en: Hereford Regional Medical Center is roughly 50 miles southwest of Amarillo.
sentences.zh: Hereford地区医疗中心位于阿马里洛西南约50英里处。

sentences.en: Shortly before Christmas, hospital officials there declared an internal state of disaster.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前不久，那里的医院官员宣布进入内部灾难状态。

sentences.en: All the travelers had gone home for the holidays, leaving the remaining staff and administrators struggling to keep the doors open.
sentences.zh: 所有的流动护士都回家过节了，留下的员工和管理人员只能艰难维持医院运转。

sentences.en: Administrative staff took shifts over Christmas and New Year's to avoid a complete shutdown.
sentences.zh: 行政人员在圣诞节和新年期间轮班，以避免医院彻底关闭。

sentences.en: Nursing teachers from Amarillo drove in to help bridge the gap between the departing and arriving traveling nurses.
sentences.zh: 来自阿马里洛的护理教师开车赶来，帮助填补离职和即将到岗的流动护士之间的空缺。

sentences.en: The hospital had stopped performing surgeries and was sending its labor and delivery patients to other hospitals.
sentences.zh: 该医院已停止进行手术，并将分娩病人转送至其他医院。

sentences.en: It could no longer take referrals, serving only the people who showed up in the emergency room, and none of the larger hospitals nearby were able to take its acute cases.
sentences.zh: 它无法再接收转诊病人，只能服务于急诊室的病人，而附近没有一家大型医院能接收其危重病例。

sentences.en: Other rural hospitals are reeling from similar shortages.
sentences.zh: 其他农村医院也正因类似的短缺而陷入困境。

sentences.en: In Missouri, one rural hospital was unable to transfer a patient with acute pneumonia after contacting 19 different hospitals.
sentences.zh: 在密苏里州，一家农村医院在联系了19家不同的医院后，仍无法转运一名患有急性肺炎的病人。

sentences.en: A nurse saved the woman's life by staying up all night, loosening the mucus in the patient's lungs with a handheld massager.
sentences.zh: 一名护士整晚没睡，用手持按摩器松动病人肺部的粘液，挽救了这位妇女的生命。

sentences.en: Rural hospitals in New Mexico have reported calling 40 or 50 hospitals in order to find a bed for acute patients.
sentences.zh: 新墨西哥州的农村医院报告称，为了给危重病人找到一张床位，他们需要拨打40到50家医院的电话。

sentences.en: Candace Smith, the chief nursing officer at Hereford Regional, said, We need staff.
sentences.zh: Hereford地区医疗中心的首席护理官Candace Smith说：我们需要员工。

sentences.en: We need supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们需要物资。

sentences.en: We need medicines.
sentences.zh: 我们需要药品。

sentences.en: We have spent multiple hours on the phone to try to get patients out of here.
sentences.zh: 我们花了几个小时打电话，试图把病人转出去。

sentences.en: If they've had a stroke or a heart attack or a traumatic brain injury, we've been getting them to Dallas or Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 如果他们中风、心脏病发作或遭受创伤性脑损伤，我们一直把他们送到达拉斯或俄克拉荷马州。

sentences.en: Smith sent a request to its regional advisory council asking for more travelers, but she wasn't sure of when or whether they might show up.
sentences.zh: Smith向区域咨询委员会提交了申请，请求派遣更多流动护士，但她不确定他们何时会来，甚至不确定他们是否会来。

sentences.en: As a rural hospital, we can't pay for them forever, she told me.
sentences.zh: 作为一家农村医院，我们无法永远支付他们的费用，她告诉我。

sentences.en: It will cripple the healthcare industry.
sentences.zh: 这会摧毁整个医疗行业。

sentences.en: There has been an evolution in the travelers, Smith continued.
sentences.zh: 流动护士群体发生了演变，Smith继续说道。

sentences.en: Now they don't come here or to any facility and say, What can I do?
sentences.zh: 现在他们来到这里或任何医疗机构时，不会再问：我能做些什么？

sentences.en: I'm willing to work any day you tell me to.
sentences.zh: 我愿意在你要求的任何一天工作。

sentences.en: Now they say, I'm only going to work Sunday, Monday, Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 现在他们说：我只会在周日、周一、周二工作。

sentences.en: I'm going to take off for
sentences.zh: 我要请假过

sentences.en: Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节。

sentences.en: When I asked Smith if there was anything else she wanted to share, she said simply, Just tell people to pray for us.
sentences.zh: 当我问Smith还有什么想分享的吗，她只是简单地说：告诉大家为我们祈祷吧。

sentences.en: In light of the grim staffing numbers, both city and rural hospitals have tried to focus on retention efforts, in some cases mirroring the benefits of the travel nursing industry.
sentences.zh: 鉴于严峻的人员配置数据，城市和农村医院都试图专注于留住员工，在某些情况下，甚至效仿旅行护理行业的福利待遇。

sentences.en: Northwest now offers higher overtime rates for nurses who take extra shifts, and BSA started offering better pay overall.
sentences.zh: Northwest现在为加班的护士提供更高的加班费，BSA也开始提供更好的整体薪酬。

sentences.en: In Florida, hospitals are hiring recent nursing graduates and placing them in nursing teams with more experienced personnel.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州，医院正在招聘刚毕业的护理系学生，并将他们与更有经验的人员组成护理团队。

sentences.en: UAMS Medical Center at the University of
sentences.zh: 阿肯色大学医学科学分校的

sentences.en: Arkansas for Medical Sciences is offering a signing bonus of $25,000 to qualified nurses willing to stay for three years.
sentences.zh: UAMS医学中心为愿意留任三年的合格护士提供2.5万美元的签约奖金。

sentences.en: At Parkland Health and Hospital System in Dallas, doctors have been helping ease the burden on nurses by performing some of their duties.
sentences.zh: 在达拉斯的帕克兰健康与医院系统，医生们通过分担部分职责来减轻护士的负担。

sentences.en: Rhonda Crow is the chief nursing officer at Moore
sentences.zh: Rhonda Crow是Moore县医院区的首席护理官，

sentences.en: County Hospital District, a nonprofit that serves Dumas, Texas and the surrounding rural areas.
sentences.zh: 这是一家服务于德克萨斯州杜马市及周边农村地区的非营利机构。

sentences.en: She has spent nearly 10 years working on hiring and retaining nurses, including implementing scholarship programs to help local students through nursing school.
sentences.zh: 她花了近10年时间致力于招聘和留住护士，包括实施奖学金计划，帮助当地学生完成护理学业。

sentences.en: Everyone was paid a full salary throughout the pandemic, whether they were scheduled to work or not.
sentences.zh: 整个疫情期间，无论是否被安排工作，每个人都领到了全额工资。

sentences.en: An incentive, Crow hoped, to stay.
sentences.zh: Crow希望这能成为一种留人的激励措施。

sentences.en: We're lucky here in Dumas, she told me.
sentences.zh: 我们在杜马很幸运，她告诉我。

sentences.en: The hospital has the backing of a foundation that helps with funding.
sentences.zh: 这家医院有基金会的支持，可以提供资金帮助。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, Crow has managed to increase her staff and now has the ability to open every bed in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 疫情期间，Crow成功增加了员工人数，现在有能力开放医院的所有床位。

sentences.en: By staffing up, it gives me the opportunity to grow nurse leaders, Crow said.
sentences.zh: 通过增加人手，我有了培养护士领导者的机会，Crow说。

sentences.en: Is it an expensive gamble?
sentences.zh: 这是一场昂贵的赌博吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Will it pay off in the end?
sentences.zh: 最终会有回报吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Other rural hospitals, however, will continue to struggle.
sentences.zh: 然而，其他农村医院将继续挣扎。

sentences.en: Without state support, many can't afford to pay the higher wages that nurses that nurses are commanding.
sentences.zh: 如果没有州政府的支持，许多医院无法负担护士们要求的更高工资。

sentences.en: Fewer patients are insured, and many are older, their illnesses more severe, and experienced nurses are continuing to leave for other, lower-stress jobs.
sentences.zh: 参加保险的病人越来越少，许多病人年龄较大，病情更严重，而经验丰富的护士正不断离职去寻找压力较小的工作。

sentences.en: There are around 153,000 new nurses being licensed every year, but based on projected demand, it will not be enough.
sentences.zh: 每年大约有15.3万名新护士获得执照，但根据预计需求，这还远远不够。

sentences.en: For Barasa, each new spike in COVID patients seems to happen overnight.
sentences.zh: 对于Barasa来说，新冠病人的每一次激增似乎都是一夜之间发生的。

sentences.en: He may know a surge is coming.
sentences.zh: 他可能知道激增即将来临。

sentences.en: He may worry about families gathering for the holidays, but the influx always feels sudden.
sentences.zh: 他可能会担心人们在假期聚会，但这种涌入总是让人感到猝不及防。

sentences.en: In the fall, COVID cases in Amarillo dropped, and the hospital was assigned fewer state-subsidized nurses.
sentences.zh: 秋季时，阿马里洛的新冠病例有所下降，医院分配到的州政府补贴护士也减少了。

sentences.en: But the moment the travelers started to leave, a wave of new COVID cases began to fill the hospital's beds.
sentences.zh: 但就在流动护士开始离开的那一刻，新一波新冠病例开始填满医院的床位。

sentences.en: Northwest scrambled to bring in travelers again.
sentences.zh: Northwest医院手忙脚乱地再次召集流动护士。

sentences.en: Then the Omicron variant arrived.
sentences.zh: 接着奥密克戎变异株出现了。

sentences.en: The hospital's exhausted nurses went into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 医院里精疲力竭的护士们进入了超负荷工作状态。

sentences.en: In late December, Shaddix texted me a gif of an exploding house.
sentences.zh: 12月下旬，Shaddix给我发了一个房子爆炸的动图。

sentences.en: It's bad, she said.
sentences.zh: 情况很糟，她说。

sentences.en: But it's fine.
sentences.zh: 但没关系。

sentences.en: We're fine.
sentences.zh: 我们很好。

sentences.en: There were new nurses in the medical intensive care unit, people who had just graduated, and Shaddix was watching them flounder.
sentences.zh: 内科重症监护室里来了新护士，都是刚毕业的学生，Shaddix看着他们手忙脚乱的样子。

sentences.en: It's a sink-or-swim situation, she said.
sentences.zh: 这是一个适者生存的环境，她说。

sentences.en: And you learn to swim really quickly, because otherwise people die.
sentences.zh: 你必须很快学会游泳，否则人们就会死去。

sentences.en: She had taken on many of the hard conversations with families, telling them that their loved ones would probably not make it.
sentences.zh: 她承担了许多与家属进行的艰难谈话，告诉他们亲人可能挺不过去了。

sentences.en: They started calling me the hospice queen, she said grimly.
sentences.zh: 他们开始叫我临终关怀女王，她冷冷地说。

sentences.en: Families were allowed to enter the ICUs, and Shaddix let them, hoping that once they saw how bad things were, how low the quality
sentences.zh: 家属被允许进入ICU，Shaddix让他们进去，希望一旦他们看到情况有多糟糕，看到家人的生活质量

sentences.en: of life was for their family members, they would start to let them go.
sentences.zh: 有多低，他们就会开始放手。

sentences.en: Early in the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 疫情初期，

sentences.en: Shaddix told me, nurses in the MICU tried to stay positive, to offer family members a ray of hope until the end.
sentences.zh: Shaddix告诉我，MICU的护士们试图保持积极，给家属带去一线希望，直到最后一刻。

sentences.en: Now they are more realistic.
sentences.zh: 现在他们更现实了。

sentences.en: They need to set expectations.
sentences.zh: 他们需要设定预期。

sentences.en: By January, Northwest had made appeals to the Regional Advisory Council and FEMA for more nurses.
sentences.zh: 到1月，Northwest医院已向区域咨询委员会和联邦紧急事务管理局请求更多护士。

sentences.en: COVID patients were filling up the emergency room and surgical floor.
sentences.zh: 新冠病人挤满了急诊室和外科病房。

sentences.en: At one point, Brian Weiss, the chief medical officer, knew of 43 patients in rural hospitals waiting for a transfer.
sentences.zh: 有一次，首席医疗官Brian Weiss得知有43名农村医院的病人正在等待转院。

sentences.en: Around 75 staff members at Northwest were in quarantine.
sentences.zh: Northwest大约有75名员工处于隔离状态。

sentences.en: While travel and military nurses began arriving, core staff continued leaving.
sentences.zh: 当旅行护士和军方护士开始到达时，核心员工却在不断流失。

sentences.en: Delaunee Spradling, a charge nurse in the MICU who never anticipated leaving, abruptly resigned in early February.
sentences.zh: MICU的主管护士Delaunee Spradling从未想过要离开，却在2月初突然辞职了。

sentences.en: Another Northwest nurse took a traveling job that moved him to the hospital across the street.
sentences.zh: 另一名Northwest的护士接受了一份流动工作，去了街对面的医院。

sentences.en: Shaddix hopes to be a traveler again.
sentences.zh: Shaddix希望再次成为一名流动护士。

sentences.en: She loves the physicians she works with at NorthweSt. She knows what labs they need and what questions they're going to ask.
sentences.zh: 她热爱在Northwest共事的医生们。她知道他们需要什么检查，也知道他们会问什么问题。

sentences.en: But staying doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 但留下来并不划算。

sentences.en: Here you are killing yourself for five days making pennies, she said, versus working four days or three days making three times what you're making right now.
sentences.zh: 她说，在这里你拼死拼活工作五天，赚的钱少得可怜，而做流动护士工作四天或三天，赚的钱却是现在的三倍。

sentences.en: Once Shaddix goes, some of the longest serving nurses in the MICU will be travelers.
sentences.zh: 一旦Shaddix离开，MICU中一些资历最深的护士都将是流动护士。

sentences.en: Many nurses are hoping to move on from the ICU entirely.
sentences.zh: 许多护士希望彻底离开ICU。

sentences.en: Kenia is starting the nurse anesthetist program in May.
sentences.zh: Kenia将于5月开始麻醉护士课程。

sentences.en: Shaddix is taking classes toward her nurse practitioner's license.
sentences.zh: Shaddix正在修读课程，以考取执业护士执照。

sentences.en: Maybe once this is all over and done with, I'll come back to the ICU and take my normal patients, she told me.
sentences.zh: 也许等这一切都结束了，我会回到ICU，照顾我的常规病人，她告诉我。

sentences.en: But if I never have to see another N95 mask in my life, I will not be sad.
sentences.zh: 但如果我这辈子再也不用看到N95口罩，我一点也不会难过。

sentences.en: Barasa is hanging on for now, providing as much continuity as he can.
sentences.zh: Barasa目前还在坚持，尽可能保持工作的连续性。

sentences.en: In December, he was working six days a week.
sentences.zh: 12月时，他每周工作六天。

sentences.en: The CICU was so full of COVID patients that it couldn't take transfers from the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 心脏重症监护室里住满了新冠病人，以至于无法接收从急诊室转来的病人。

sentences.en: We have beds, we just don't have the ability to staff them, he told me.
sentences.zh: 我们有床位，只是没有能力安排人手去照顾，他告诉我。

sentences.en: If we do bring them in, we just overwhelm people even more and possibly push them out the door.
sentences.zh: 如果我们强行接收，只会让员工更加不堪重负，甚至可能把他们逼走。

sentences.en: Barasa has begun taking patients himself in addition to overseeing all the nurses in his unit.
sentences.zh: Barasa除了监督病房的所有护士外，也开始亲自接管病人。

sentences.en: He tries to take his candy cart down to the nurses in the emergency room now.
sentences.zh: 他现在试着把他的糖果车推到急诊室给护士们。

sentences.en: He knows they are tired too.
sentences.zh: 他知道他们也很累。

sentences.en: Emergency department doctors are in such huge demand in smaller hospitals that Weiss recalled at least one at Northwest who was contacted and told to name his price.
sentences.zh: 小型医院对急诊科医生的需求量极大，Weiss回忆说，Northwest至少有一位医生被联系并被告知可以自己开价。

sentences.en: As the new year started, however, even Barasa was beginning to fray at the edges.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着新一年的开始，连Barasa也开始感到力不从心了。

sentences.en: He has been having trouble falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 他一直有入睡困难的问题。

sentences.en: He passes out on his couch most nights.
sentences.zh: 大多数晚上他都在沙发上昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I lay there and I see the people that I saw all day and the people that I saw before.
sentences.zh: 我躺在那里，脑海里浮现出我整天看到的病人，还有我之前见过的那些人。

sentences.en: I try to keep myself centered and not dwell on it too long because it puts me in a low place.
sentences.zh: 我试着让自己保持专注，不要想得太深，因为那会让我陷入低谷。

sentences.en: He thinks instead of his staff.
sentences.zh: 他替他的员工思考。

sentences.en: He thinks of the nurses who have made it out.
sentences.zh: 他挂念着那些已经挺过来的护士们。

sentences.en: He thinks of a patient who recently recovered.
sentences.zh: 他挂念着一位最近康复的病人。

sentences.en: He tries to relax, but sometimes his body won't let him forget.
sentences.zh: 他试图放松，但有时身体却不让他忘记。

sentences.en: Lately, as he tries to fall asleep, he has been feeling the phantom pressure of a hand in his.
sentences.zh: 最近，当他试图入睡时，他总能感觉到手里仿佛还握着一只手。

sentences.en: The feeling of a patient about to be intubated.
sentences.zh: 那是病人即将插管时的触感。

sentences.en: Another frightened person on the edge of life and death.
sentences.zh: 又一个徘徊在生死边缘的惊恐生命。

sentences.en: You get all these sensations and feelings, he told me.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，你会感受到所有这些知觉和情绪。

sentences.en: Feeling them grasp you.
sentences.zh: 感受着他们紧紧抓住你。

sentences.en: And feeling their grasp letting go when the medication hits them.
sentences.zh: 以及当药物起效时，感受着他们的手逐渐松开。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我是主持人莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人们的故事。

sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
